note: What the map's SYMBOLOGY costs against what its ENGINE costs, on the phone, at the declared 150 units — the A/B `?overlay=0` was built for (201/2), taken 2026-08-30 through the panel's MCP channel. Both halves are the SAME pak (17:45 12-08-2026, out ./build/phone-ls), the SAME app (e3c4831), the same district and the same circuit: four poses (1300,-1700), (1700,-1700), (1700,-1300), (1300,-1300), two laps, height 500, pitch -1, yaw 0, perspective. THE HEADLINE IS THE CPU BODY, because it is the number both halves measure the same way: 5.114 ms per drawn frame with the overlay, 2.256 without — and 3.785 of the 5.114 (74 %) is symbology and board, against the engine's own 0.723. The frame interval halves with it (moving frames only, the >=100 ms idle poll excluded: mean 53.9 -> 30.6 ms, p50 48 -> 24), and the confound works AGAINST that result rather than for it — the overlay-off half ran on a 35 % LARGER surface (622 080 against 460 800 device px, the browser's chrome collapsing), so it was doing more fragment work and still ran faster. TWO THINGS MUST BE READ WITH IT. (1) `engine-frame` goes UP, 0.723 -> 1.463, and that is SELECTION, not a cost: with nothing over the map the render gate only draws while the camera flies, so every sampled frame is a moving one, while the overlay half is diluted by cheap frames that unit motion woke. (2) The overlay-off histogram carries 192 frames under 8 ms, which no rAF can produce — they are DOUBLE loop entries from a scheduler defect found by this run (`idleTimer` is never nulled when it fires, so a later wake arms a second `requestAnimationFrame` on top of the one the drawn frame already armed). They are excluded from the percentiles above and are the reason the raw dtP50 of that half reads 19.2. Also measured: 19 of the engine's 98 draws and 36 886 of its 234 852 triangles are the symbology drawn INSIDE the 3D pass (the beacons), and the console draws 43 % fewer frames per second of wall clock with the overlay off (5.9/s against 10.4/s) while skipping more (18.8/s against 11.2/s) — the battery half of 201/4-01. GPU time is not measurable on this adapter (no timestamp-query). Device MGA-LX3 / ARM Bifrost, DPR 2.
